gate: RTK C9 HMT lambda=1 round-S3 non-scalar gauge/constraint block inventory
scope: On the same frozen round-S3, D=3, lambda=1, zero-background-momentum projectable HMT background, source-lock the remaining non-scalar gauge/constraint sectors that must be handled before combining determinant factors. This gate is an inventory/classification gate only: it does not compute the complete gauge-fixed operator, the full FP determinant, the full FS determinant, or a one-loop effective action.

source_locks.source: Horava and Melby-Thompson, Phys. Rev. D 82, 064027 (2010), arXiv:1007.2410
source_locks.locked_claim: The projectable HMT construction enlarges foliation-preserving diffeomorphisms by a local U(1), removes the scalar graviton, and has lambda=1 in the original minimal construction.
Hamiltonian analysis of nonrelativistic covariant/projectable Horava-Lifshitz gravity contains first- and second-class constraints yielding the correct gravitational physical degree-of-freedom count.

source_locks.source: Kluson et al., Eur. Phys. J. C 71, 1690 (2011), arXiv:1012.0473
source_locks.locked_claim: The U(1)-invariant projectable F(R) construction has the same Hamiltonian structure as nonrelativistic covariant HMT gravity and only transverse graviton polarizations around flat background; its HMT limit source-locks the scalar second-class pair used in prior RTK gates.

required_inventory: Separate Faddeev-Senjanovic second-class factors from Faddeev-Popov first-class gauge factors and from physical Hessian sectors; do not combine these categories.

Classify the previously source-locked Phi1/Phi2 second-class pair as a scalar constraint block; do not invent an additional vector/tensor second-class determinant without an explicit source-locked constraint pair.

Retain local spatial-diffeomorphism gauge fixing as an OPEN operator problem with longitudinal-scalar and transverse-vector harmonic sectors on S3; the prior ell=1 scalar/conformal gauge classification does not constitute the full spatial FP determinant.
Retain the projectable time-reparametrization/lapse sector as a global (spatially homogeneous) gauge/constraint block rather than a local non-scalar determinant.
Retain the local HMT U(1) nu-shift FP factor as field-independent in the previously frozen nu=0 gauge, subject to global/boundary zero-mode qualifications.
Classify transverse-traceless tensor gravitons as physical Hessian modes, not FP or FS determinant factors. Their one-loop Hessian is not computed by this gate.
Do not infer that absence of an identified non-scalar second-class pair implies the complete non-scalar measure is trivial: unresolved spatial-diffeomorphism FP and physical Hessian operators remain.
Do not import ordinary projectable-Horava beta functions, choose unresolved HMT matter coefficients, change thresholds, allow soft-s retest, unblock k=0.03 production, or mix DSIR.
pass_condition: A mutually exclusive source-consistent block inventory is produced in which the known FS second-class pair remains scalar, spatial-diffeomorphism FP sectors remain explicitly open in scalar-longitudinal and transverse-vector harmonics, the projectable time sector is global, the frozen U(1) nu FP factor remains field-independent, TT tensors are physical Hessian modes, and no full determinant/one-loop/C9 closure is claimed.
fail_condition: The audit invents an unsourced non-scalar second-class determinant, conflates FP/FS/Hessian factors, treats the ell=1 scalar gauge witness as the complete spatial FP quotient, promotes the global projectable lapse mode to a local determinant, or weakens any frozen full-theory semantic restriction.
